searchText: ***CONSIGNMENT*** Used Thor Motor Coach Class C RV for sale - 2024 Thor Motor Coach Four Winds 28A is approximately 29' 9' in length with 55,789 miles and 0 slides. Features Exterior MEGA-Storage Cab Over Loft 68' Sofa More About This RV Whether you are couple or a family, this coach offers so many comforts you might never go back home! There is a rear bedroom offering a walk-around queen bed with storage on each side, and a split bathroom allowing two people to get ready at once. You'll love the living room furniture that can double as sleeping space for overnight guests, along with the cab-over bunk. There are full kitchen amenities such as a gas cooktop and microwave, plus the 12V refrigerator is next to the mid-coach entry allowing you to grab a beverage on your way out to relax under the power awning with integrated LED lighting. There is more to enjoy like the 39' Smart TV with swivel for the perfect view of the game, the dream dinette for dining and working, the sofa to relax on, and the cab over bunk to take a nap. With any Four Winds Class C gas motorhome, you can travel in a trustworthy Ford E-Series chassis with 325HP, or a Chevrolet chassis with 401HP if you choose that option which is available on several models. Each is built with welded sidewall cage construction and a welded tubular aluminum roof, a one-piece fiberglass cap, and includes a slick fiberglass exterior with graphics package for style and years of enjoyment on the open road. Inside, you will enjoy the well-equipped kitchen, the spacious bathroom, the sleeping accommodations and the Winegard ConnecT 2.0 WiFi/4G/TV antenna that allows you to stay connected. With several floorplans to choose from and options to add, you will surely find one that fits your family's needs or your friend's approval. Choose today!
